input.quote: Each Party shall perform all Research activities under this Agreement in compliance with all Applicable Law (including GMP, GLP and GCP). In furtherance and not in limitation of the foregoing, RevMed shall use diligent efforts to conduct its activities under each Research Plan in accordance with the terms of such Research Plan (including timelines)
input.rationale: This is an R&D collaboration and license, not a software/services procurement, so the rule maps onto the performance-standard and warranty package rather than a conformance-to-documentation period. RevMed is bound to a real performance standard (Section 4.2(b): all Research activities in compliance with Applicable Law including GMP, GLP and GCP, plus diligent efforts to follow the Research Plan and timelines), gives a compliance-with-laws warranty on all prior research (13.2(u)) and a continuing mutual compliance covenant (13.4(b)), and gives an extensive suite of title, non-infringement and IP-integrity warranties in 13.2. The remedy path is meaningful and better than repair/replace/refund: a JRDC-supervised cure process with specified corrective actions and step-in/other rights for Sanofi if RevMed fails to cure (p0292), express indemnification for material breach of RevMed's warranties (p0583), and termination for material breach. The 13.5 disclaimer expressly preserves everything stated in Article XIII, which is where all express warranties sit, so it does not swallow the express warranty and this is nowhere near "AS IS" walk-away territory. Two sub-elements short of the preferred wording are noted but not flagged: RevMed's 13.2 warranties are made as of the Execution Date only (mitigated by the closing bring-down in 13.6(a)), and the 13.5 carve-out is drafted by reference to "THIS ARTICLE XIII" rather than the whole Agreement, so warranty-like commitments elsewhere (e.g., Section 4.2(b)) rely on their status as covenants rather than warranties.
